title: Prices in Part History are searchable only by users who see prices
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users (Admin, user without financial data) · 2 browsers · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • User: [User-B] = a staff member whose custom role [Role-B] has 'Part Library & Inventory → View' and See Financial Data off.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = tracked part whose Sell Price was changed from $20.00 to $23.45.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Settings → Roles & Permissions, click "Create custom role", skip the template, name it (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL NOPRICE"), turn on the Parts department, tick 'Part Library & Inventory → View', and leave See Financial Data off, click Save. [Role-B] = that role.
  2. Go to Settings → Staff, add a staff member (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST", last name "PL NOPRICE") with an email address you can open, Role [Role-B]; save, open the invite email and set a password. [User-B] = that user.
  3. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL PRICE PART), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PRICE-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  4. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PRICE-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL PRICE PART).
  5. Open [Part-A], change Sell Price to $23.45 and Save.
  6. Check the setup worked: as [Admin], [Part-A]'s Part History shows a price entry containing 23.45; [User-B] can open [Part-A]'s Part History in browser 2.
custom_steps:
1. As [Admin] open [Part-A]'s Part History and search "23.45".
  2. In browser 2, as [User-B], open [Part-A]'s Part History and search "23.45".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: The price entry is listed.
  • Step 2: No entry is found by the price.
